data.action: 立于舞台中央单手举起指挥棒，彼岸花瓣旋舞
data.animaCaption: Standing center stage inside a moonlit ruined opera house, she raises a crimson conductor's baton while red spider lilies bloom along the boards and petals drift through the silver light.
data.camera: 全身镜头，微仰视舞台透视
data.description: 穹顶破损的古典歌剧院废墟舞台上，月光如银色聚光灯倾泻而下，弗洛洛身着黑红燕尾指挥礼服，抬手轻握猩红指挥棒，彼岸花飞舞。
data.lighting: 破损穹顶倾泻的清冷月光柱与暗红残响微光
data.location: 月光废墟歌剧院中央舞台
data.promptProse: Beneath the shattered dome of a moonlit opera house, Phrolova stands upon the weathered wooden stage in her black-and-crimson conductor tailcoat, raising her baton amidst swirling spider lily petals.
data.title: 弗洛洛 · 废墟歌剧院月光舞台举起指挥棒
